name: Weapon Wheel Pause
author: Moritz Wallinger, glawks and Henning Berge
description: Pause Ratchet & Clank while choosing a weapon, with Going Commando's own quick select code: hold Triangle and the world holds (Going Commando's pause, no freeze dialog) while the stick or the d-pad picks a weapon, with Going Commando's ammo and name text; let go to equip it. A double tap is the quick swap. Ratchet & Clank's own ring, icons, names and slots. Going Commando's black bars are left out, and by default Triangle is held a little longer than in Going Commando before the pause (a setting). Needs OpenRAC with mod interface 1.39 and the hook points rac1.level.update_play, rac1.freeze.update and rac1.freeze.draw.

conflicts.reason: the earlier Pause Weapon Wheel: both replace the quick select (rac1.hud.quick_select.*) and pause the game while it is open

settings.name: Pause while open
settings.description: Going Commando's option: the world holds while the quick select is open (its game mode 4). Off: it opens over the running game, from Ratchet & Clank's own Triangle.

settings.name: Hold before pausing
settings.description: How long Triangle is held before the quick select pauses the game. Going Commando: its own 4 frames (a 15th of a second); a natural tap is often that long, so running and double-tap swapping pause briefly. A little longer (the default, longer than Going Commando's): 8 frames, so taps and double taps usually do not pause. Longer: 12 frames. On PAL each is scaled to its 50 ticks a second (3, 7, 10).

settings.name: Click sound
settings.description: A sound as the selection moves, where Going Commando clicks. Ratchet & Clank's quick select is silent and has no UI click: on, it plays the level's sound bank's first entry (the one a help message opens with), a stand-in, not Going Commando's sound. Off (the default) keeps Ratchet & Clank's silence.
